source_role: Motivates examining braking delay. No event parameter below is a calibrated reconstruction.
limitations: Assumed recognition at time zero in both conditions; detection and prediction failures are not simulated.
Fixed conflict line remains occupied; no pedestrian trajectory or evasive steering.
Instantaneous constant braking after delay; no brake build-up, jerk, gradient or tyre model.
No empirical human response distribution, driver-monitoring benefit or Level 2 versus Level 3 effectiveness test.
Grid counts are design scenarios, not probabilities; no chi-square or p-value for synthetic cases.
